rules.selection: 5-session Minervini RS (3/6/12M 40/30/30) percentile 50% + point-in-time EPS/revenue percentile 50%, top 10

universe.label: 연도별 Top 200
universe.rule: execution year y uses snapshot y-1

limitations: DART is missing for some annual-universe names; only those signal candidates are excluded and each rebalance records dartCandidateCount.

COMPARISON RUN: Yahoo adjusted OHLC is used to align this point-in-time universe test with the current-universe baseline. Yahoo adjustment provenance and delisting consideration are not official KRX/DART verification.

Yahoo series missing or failing the baseline price-jump screen is excluded under the user-approved exclusion policy. Coverage is retained per year in the JSON ledger; this run deliberately waives the normal 90% coverage gate.
Annual membership reduces but does not eliminate delisting, halt, and historical-liquidity bias.
